verses.text: Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A song. His foundation [is] on the holy mountains.

segments.text: Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A song. His foundation [is] on the holy mountains.

verses.text: YHWH loves the gates of Zion above all the dwellings of Jacob.

segments.text: YHWH loves the gates of Zion above all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.text: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

segments.text: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah

verses.text: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me—behold Philistia and Tyre, with Cush: This one was born there.

segments.text: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me—behold Philistia and Tyre, with Cush: This one was born there.

verses.text: And of Zion it will be said: “[This] man and [that] man were born in her; and He, the Most High, will establish her.”

segments.text: And of Zion it will be said: “[This] man and [that] man were born in her; and He, the Most High, will establish her.”

verses.text: YHWH will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born there.” Selah

segments.text: YHWH will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born there.” Selah

verses.text: and those singing, also as players on instruments: “All my springs [are] in you.”
